name: Wallpaper picker
author: skll
description: Omarchy's background switcher with OmaCraft's wallpapers: the theme's backgrounds, a Wallhaven search, the downloaded library and your favourites, each a tab of slanted previews. Picking one sets it through the Studio plugin's hyprskin, colours and all, without opening OmaCraft. OmaCraft's Wallpapers page sets its key.
